name: Incubus
source:
"Incubus" is a game that starts when the pure-hearted male protagonist meets an incubus at the age of 30.

The incubus introduces the player to a world they have not experienced before, and in return, the player engages in a demonic contract to provide what the incubus requires.

Help the player grow into a true man during the 30-day contract period.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1973080/]Steam[/url]]
